newsitem.title: BENIN: U.S. firm to search for oil off Benin.
newsitem.headline: U.S. firm to search for oil off Benin.

text.p: U.S. oil firm Tarpon, part of BETIS, has signed an agreement with the Benin government to search for oil in an offshore field in the West African state.

Government officials said the deal was for exploration and exploitation in a 630 sq km block for a period of six years, during which Tarpon will drill three test wells, one of them 14 months following Thursday's signing of the contract.
Reserves are estimated at 1.60 billion barrels. The government will take a 51 percent share of production and Tarpon, the rest, the officials said.
Benin, the tiny western neighbour of OPEC member Nigeria, has not found oil in commerical quantity despite a search by five different companies since 1982.
